definitions.gloss: contribution of an article; written submission
definitions.explanation: The act of writing and submitting an article, essay, or other piece of writing to a newspaper, magazine, journal, or website. Also refers to the submitted piece itself.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新聞|しんぶん}→新聞：01440_shinbun⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{寄稿|きこう}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I contributed an article to the newspaper.

examples.japanese: ⟦{専門家|せんもんか}→専門家：03088_senmonka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{雑誌|ざっし}→雑誌：00686_zasshi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{寄稿|きこう}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{記事|きじ}→記事：00227_kiji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}んだ→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
examples.english: I read an article contributed by an expert to a magazine.

examples.japanese: ⟦{教授|きょうじゅ}→教授：02589_kyouju⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{学会誌|がっかいし}→学会誌：25730_gakkaishi⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{寄稿|きこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{依頼|いらい}→依頼：02594_irai⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I was asked by a professor to contribute to an academic journal.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal term used in publishing and academic contexts. Often used with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ to form a verb ({寄稿|きこう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧). The contributor is called ⟦{寄稿者|きこうしゃ}→寄稿者：22699_kikousha⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {寄稿|きこう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to contribute an article)
- {寄稿|きこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{依頼|いらい}する→依頼する：21376_irai⟧ (to request a contribution)
- ⟦{寄稿者|きこうしゃ}→寄稿者：22699_kikousha⟧ (contributor)
- {寄稿|きこう}⟦{記事|きじ}→記事：00227_kiji⟧ (contributed article)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{投稿|とうこう}→投稿：04733_toukou⟧: submission, post — broader, includes social media posts, letters to editors, and user-generated content
- ⟦{執筆|しっぴつ}→執筆：04194_shippitsu⟧: writing — the act of writing itself, not specifically submitting to a publication
